snippet.title: Shogo M.A.D VR Mod Preview 2 | More Mechs Please!
snippet.description:
Showcasing more gameplay, trying to contrast my first video with more mech centric footage! 

Made clarity improvements to the hud, general in game text, and the game itself overall. I added in a new dedicated in game VR settings submenu for people to tinker with. I added in a left handed mode that swaps the control schemes from your hands, simulated two hand aiming (you can turn it off, too if you prefer) and other QoL VR features like the ability to change your turn from smooth turn to degree turning in game and so on

I fixed the vehicle mode bug, basically what was happening was each time you'd transform your FOV would go completely insane, and the whole game view would become incredibly blurry, it was not the best experience for VR to say the least

I started using the thirdperson player models to simulate your "VR body". They currently are a bit limited; there are a couple problems with the mech's thirdperson models as they have quite a few instances where they clip into your eyes which is not the best. Personally, I recommend just turning them off while you're in your mobile armor suit for now. When you go into vehicle mode and back out again into mech mode your model's animations get bugged. Meh on that to say the least.



The music track is "The Course" from the original Unreal Tournament (1999)

https://github.com/BrandonW24/Shogo-VR
